introHtml: Blue custom multi function tools combine the practicality of everyday carry gear with a color that stands out in a crowd. Whether you are outfitting a safety team with a reliable multi-tool or handing out branded gadgets at a tradeshow, blue tools are easy to spot and remember. Options like the Gripper Multi-Tool or the 8-in-1 Aluminum Multi-Tool Kit can be imprinted with your logo using laser engraving or pad printing, ensuring your brand stays visible every time the tool is used.
